extName.message: Website Insights Tool: Rank, Age, Tech & SEO

extDescription.message: See any site's popularity rank, domain age, tech stack, SEO checks and speed in one click. Free data, no account, no tracking.

unsupported_page.message: Open a website (http or https) and click the icon again to see its insights.

page_blocked.message: This page can't be inspected by extensions (for example browser or store pages). Rank and domain data above still apply.

no_domain_data.message: Rank and domain data aren't available for IP addresses or local hosts.

err_rate_limited.message: The data source is busy. Try again in a few seconds.

err_network.message: Couldn't reach the data source. Check your connection.

err_auth.message: The API key or token was rejected. Check it in settings.

err_quota.message: The API quota is used up for now.

tranco_unranked.message: Not in the top 1 million websites. Traffic is likely modest.

radar_hint.message: Add a free Cloudflare token to also see the Cloudflare Radar rank, site categories and top countries.

radar_permission.message: Cloudflare Radar needs permission to contact api.cloudflare.com. Save the token again in settings to grant it.

rdap_unsupported.message: The .$1 registry doesn't publish public RDAP records, so the registration date isn't available.

rdap_not_found.message: The registry has no record for this domain.

tech_none.message: No known technologies detected on this page.

tech_note.message: Detected from the page's code and response headers. Server-side tools that leave no trace in the browser can't be seen.

seo_page_note.message: Checks this page only, as your browser sees it.

seod_alt_missing.message: $1 of $2 images have no alt text

seod_noindex.message: Blocked by a noindex robots meta tag

seod_headers_unavailable.message: The site didn't return headers to the check, so security headers weren't evaluated.

speed_local_note.message: Measured from this tab's page load on your device and network. Reload the page for fresh numbers.

cls_unsupported.message: CLS isn't reported by this browser.

crux_hint.message: Add a free Google API key to see how real Chrome users experience this site (Core Web Vitals).

crux_no_data.message: Not enough real-user traffic for Google to publish data for this site.

crux_note.message: 75th percentile of Chrome users on all devices over the last 28 days.

psi_privacy.message: Sends this page's address (without query string) to Google PageSpeed Insights.

psi_no_key.message: Without an API key, Google's shared free quota is often used up.

psi_need_key.message: Google's shared free quota is used up. Add your own free API key to run tests.

options_subtitle.message: Optional API keys and privacy information

opt_how_to_get.message: How to get one for free

opt_google_desc.message: Unlocks real-user Core Web Vitals from the Chrome UX Report and reliable PageSpeed Insights lab tests. Without it, the Speed tab still shows metrics measured in your own tab.

opt_google_step1.message: Open Google Cloud Console and create (or pick) a project.

opt_google_step2.message: Enable “PageSpeed Insights API” and “Chrome UX Report API” (links below).

opt_google_step3.message: Go to Credentials → Create credentials → API key.

opt_google_step4.message: Paste the key here and click Save. Both APIs are free.

opt_cf_desc.message: Adds the Cloudflare Radar popularity rank, site categories and top countries. Saving asks for permission to contact api.cloudflare.com only.

opt_cf_step1.message: Sign in to Cloudflare (a free account is enough) and open My Profile → API Tokens.

opt_cf_step2.message: Create a Custom Token with the permission Account → Radar → Read.

opt_cf_step3.message: Paste the token here and click Save, then allow the permission prompt.

opt_cf_permission_denied.message: Permission for api.cloudflare.com wasn't granted, so the token wasn't saved.

privacy_intro.message: Website Insights Tool has no servers, no accounts and no analytics. It only works when you click its icon, and it sends requests directly from your browser to public data sources:

privacy_row_cf.message: You open the popup, only if you added a Cloudflare token

privacy_row_google.message: You open the popup, only if you added a Google API key

privacy_sent_url.message: The page address without query string or fragment

privacy_sent_page.message: Requests for the page headers, /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml, without cookies

privacy_to_rdap.message: The domain's registry RDAP server (found via data.iana.org)

privacy_local.message: API keys and cached results (kept up to 7 days) are stored only in your browser's local extension storage. Nothing is synced or shared.

privacy_none.message: The extension does not collect, sell or transmit your browsing history, personal data or page contents to the developer or anyone else.
